test_cases.name: wait-task
test_cases.description: Wait (block) for a task to finish; polls every 5s, returns once status != RUNNING
test_cases.expected: JSON task dict once status leaves RUNNING (COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELLED)
test_cases.prerequisite: A task created via create-task (TC-05); wait-task does not create tasks

test_cases.name: wait-task-timeout
test_cases.description: Verify wait-task honors --timeout (min 1s); raises TimeoutError / CLI exits 1 if task still RUNNING
test_cases.expected: Timeout shown as [ERROR] and non-zero exit if task not terminal within timeout

variables.session_id: Dispatcher session id (required for all dispatch ops)
variables.robot_id: Target robot id (for create-task / list filter)

notes: All dispatch operations are session-scoped and require a valid session_id
Mutating tests (TC-05, TC-11) require user confirmation before execution
TC-15/TC-16 use wait-task to block until a task finishes (polls every 5s); wait-task does NOT create a task — run TC-05 first to obtain a task_id
These tests use the CURRENT FE2026052100144 interface (create-task etc.); do NOT use deprecated create-session/exec-task
Subagents may reuse old IDs giving stale cache; if results look stale, wait (60+ minutes) and re-query
For comprehensive end-to-end testing beyond these read-only checks, run the commands from SKILL.md manually
